description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Freezing Downpour], Innate Talent +1 and [Tactical Shot Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Freezing Action
description.text: 6/3 single ranged attacks (0.90 each) if user has Innate Talent 0/1, grants [Ice Ability +30% Boost 3] if user has Innate Talent 1, causes Innate Talent -1 to the user

description.name: Attach Ice 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Ice Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Ice 3

description.name: Freezing Downpour
description.text: Grants [125% ATB (Synchro)]/[200% ATB (Synchro)] after using 1/2+ Ice abilities

description.name: Tactical Shot Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Tactical Shot after casting Freezing Bombshell or Freezing Action

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
